commit.message: docs(titanium): record WP-0S live exposure observation

interface_mismatches: Fresh read-only probes observe two externally reachable dashboard-family health endpoints, including a publicly bound Meghadharma container returning HTTP 200, but no operator attestation or containment decision exists.

Meghadharma carries two distinct runtimes: the old loopback backend has DASHBOARD_API_KEY by name, while the public dharmic-quant-web container has none of DASHBOARD_API_KEY, DHARMA_VERIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET, or DHARMA_API_MODE; host-level union must not erase that distinction.

Rushabdev runs remote API head a370d3cd51aa5d9f97b2c2654d99fa63b8ab9466; local commit-graph verification shows integrated WP-0S commit e96674d27 is not its ancestor, while the remote clone lacks that object and was not mutated or fetched.
honest_blockers: This implementation-observer receipt cannot attest the complete deployment inventory or issue an operator containment decision.
inventory_complete remains false and the typed verdict remains BLOCKED_OPERATOR; PASS, CLOSED_NOT_PROD, and CLOSED_LIVE are forbidden without exact-scope operator attestation.
The packet records observations only and performs no host mutation, service restart, firewall or proxy change, credential creation, deployment, repository setting change, or merge.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the validator, focused tests, observation receipt, and packet together. Preserve all external host state and observation facts; rollback grants no authority to mutate or reinterpret them.
